sources.entry: MyBB - Free, extensible forum software package. (Source Code) LGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: MyBB is a free, open source forum software written in PHP that supports MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite.
summary.what_it_does: MyBB is a forum (message board) application licensed under the GNU LGPL v3. The README describes it as written in PHP with support for MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL/SQLite databases. The README points to external resources for downloading the latest stable release, documentation for usage and administration, and an "Extend MyBB" area for plugins, themes and translations. It also links to community forums and a Discord server for support. The README includes a short section pointing to CONTRIBUTING.md for running MyBB locally and submitting changes. Installation specifics and feature lists are not in the README itself.
use_cases: run a message board for a website
customize forum with plugins and themes
self-host a forum on a PHP server
run a forum with PostgreSQL or SQLite backend
how_to_run: Download the latest stable release from mybb.com/download
See CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository for running MyBB locally
notable: Supports MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite databases
Extensible through plugins, themes and translations via Extend MyBB
caveats: README does not list features or detailed installation steps; these are in external docs
Plugins and themes come from the separate Extend MyBB site, not this repository
